name: Case 1: Viral Breaking News Graphic
claimText: Government announcing mandatory biometric chip implants for all citizens by November 2026
description: Circulating graphic imitating an official news channel lower-third banner with fake ministerial quote.
notes: Major syndicated republishing network repeating identical headline. High contradiction from official fact-checkers.

name: Case 2: Emergency Voice/Imposter Extortion DM
claimText: Urgent: Dad is in emergency hospital ward after highway accident. Transfer 45,000 INR immediately to Dr. Sharma UPI: 9811223344@paytm
description: WhatsApp forward and SMS panic message containing urgency cues, emotional manipulation, and an unverified UPI handle.
notes: Emergency scam trigger detected. High linguistic coercion, zero verifiable clinical records, known phishing UPI format.

name: Case 3: Morphed Celebrity / Political Photo
claimText: Leaked photograph of high-ranking diplomat meeting foreign arms contractor at private resort
description: Viral photo showing spliced head-swap, mismatched specular lighting reflections, and missing original camera EXIF tags.
notes: ELA heatmap highlights localized high-frequency compression block discrepancies around head and collar borders.
